messages:
arjun: Heads-up — customer X finished their security audit this morning. They flagged data residency + FIPS parity as blockers for Dedicated/Private in their PoC. We need an emergency scope re-eval for the upcoming milestone.

sophia: Thanks. Can we get a quick list of what would be required to satisfy the audit? rough order-of-magnitude on time/cost please.

mike: From infra side: FIPS-compliant TLS + a FIPS-mode build, add KMS/HSM integration path, and an option to disable cross-region caching for residency. Roughly 3-4 engineer-weeks to get a hardened build and 2 weeks to wiring tests.

denise: Confirming: audit requires FIPS-140-2 level crypto for keys in transit AND at-rest for their contract. They also want key rotation proof points and plaintext-free logs for some tenants.

arjun: That's more than we anticipated for this milestone. Sophia — recommend we reprioritize. Two options: 1) push residency/FIPS to v1 and keep MVP focused on core serving + UX, or 2) scope MVP to Dedicated-only with residency gated behind a launch toggle. Thoughts?

sophia: My take: option 2 minimizes customer churn — we can promise Dedicated-only for the PoC with a clear v1 plan for multi-region/residency. But we need to be explicit in the launch criteria.

mike: For option 2 we'd still need a Dedicated plan: gating logic, config flags, and test harness. That's 1.5 engineer-weeks + QA. Far less than full FIPS path.

jordan: Ops note: making it Dedicated-only buys time on infra compliance but increases support surface (we'll need operations runbook + manual checks). I can draft runbook in 3 days.

denise: If we go Dedicated-only, we must still avoid logging tenant PII. I'll add a minimal logging toggle and a small regex scrubber — ~2 dev-days.

sophia: Proposed cutlist for MVP (quick):
```
- Keep: core inference APIs, model pinning, basic telemetry
- Cut/Delay to v1: multi-region residency, FIPS-mode, full KMS/HSM rotation proofs, advanced routing policies
- MVP additions (Dedicated-only): residency flag, minimal logging scrubber, Dedicated runbook
```

arjun: That looks reasonable. Timeline reset proposal: shift release candidate by 2 weeks to accommodate Dedicated runbook + gating + QA. Can we absorb that?

mike: Yes. Team can absorb 2-week slip if we freeze any non-critical infra experiments. Need approvals from Eng Leadership.

sophia: I'll update the milestone board and notify Sales/CS. Also setting a hard launch criteria checklist: Dedicated deployment validated, runbook + support oncall confirmed, acceptance test pass (security subset).

denise: I'll draft the security acceptance checklist and link to the audit notes. Expect a first draft by EOD tomorrow.

arjun: Action items: @sophia update roadmap & milestone, @mike schedule 1.5w sprint for gating + QA, @jordan draft runbook, @denise produce acceptance checklist. I'll loop in eng leads for approval.

deploy-bot: Deploy plan check: no scheduled deploys to Dedicated clusters between now and milestone freeze (automated hold set). :lock: 

sophia: Thanks everyone — I'll post the updated milestone + diff note in #product in 30m and ping customers. :pulse:
